c2-expected-reachability.json — C2 lineage-reachability write-time hard-reject oracle.
Distinct from expected-rejections.json (schema.js shape/cross-field oracle, fs/git-free by
design). Every fixture here is shape-VALID per schema.js — it is REJECTED (or, for the
positive carve-out fixture, ACCEPTED) only by the filesystem/git-aware reachability pass
hosted in the PreToolUse hook (coordinator/hooks/scripts/validate-frontmatter-schema.js),
AFTER the schema.js shape pass. Consumed by
coordinator/hooks/scripts/__tests__/c2-lineage-reachability.test.js, which spawns the hook
with COORDINATOR_SCHEMA_STRICT=1 (deny-always posture applies even without strict, but
strict makes the assertion unambiguous — deny vs additionalContext-warn — see hook header).

Recovery-SHA carve-out (PM-ratified 2026-07-08, same-repo-only): a kind:recovery predecessor
SHA that is not git cat-file -e reachable is NOT auto-rejected — it may be a legitimate
sibling-repo crash SHA (foreign-baton boundary, deliberately deferred, see plan § Anti-scope).
There is no per-record repo-identity discriminator, so this carve-out is unconditional: any
unreachable recovery SHA passes. c2-04-recovery-sha-unreachable.md therefore has
expect_reject: false — it is the POSITIVE carve-out fixture (claude-klabauter F2 hard adoption
condition), not a negative rejection case, despite its filename echoing the plan's
'recovery-sha-unreachable' Test-surface bullet.
